notes.title: Update notes for v0.1.26
notes.content:
We've pushed a new update which includes:

[list]
[*] Adds over 30 new status effects that the player can have applied from stats, food and the environment.
[*] Fixes issue caused when passing out due to low health and energy.
[/list]

If you experience any bugs or issues jump in the discord and let us know and we'll do our best to resolve it. Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs and helped with information about issues so far. We appreciate it.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.1.25
notes.content:
Hello! 

We've added four new hair styles for your character! (Visit the robot in the medical centre on Vauxhall Station to make changes.)

More updates to come soon, including asteroid and derelict variations to explore, and more in-depth status effects.

We're also still working on lots of art for new locations and characters, which should start being added over the next couple of months.

Happy spacefaring!

<3 Ghost Cat

[/list]

If you experience any bugs or issues jump in the discord and let us know and we'll do our best to resolve it. Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs and helped with information about issues so far. We appreciate it.

notes.title: New Player Base
notes.content:
The new masculine player base is here! Featuring all the clothing and hair options available to the original feminine player base, plus a new short spiky hairstyle for both types.

If you have an existing character that you’d like to modify, head over to Vauxhall Space Station and talk to the robot in the Medical center just inside the entrance.

We’ve also added a new longer day option under the settings menu for those who’d like to play at a more relaxed pace, as well as continued bug fixes and touch ups.

Feel free to hop over to our discord to ask any questions, report bugs, or just share pictures of your cat.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/gMV6vS4Z6t]Join our Discord![/url]

notes.title: Update notes for v0.1.13
notes.content:
We've pushed a new update which includes:

* Updates how sensors cargo cam view is displayed to prevent staying on screen.
* Updates containers save and load to prevent resetting.
* Hides HUD until in level when loading game.
* Fixes save and load for Botany environmental settings.
* Fixes missing engineering stat in player progress UI.
* Hides interaction icon when NPC is in a chair or other enterable.
* Updates Refinery UI to format text correctly.

You can chat to us on discord to report bugs, give feedback or get help playing the game :)

notes.title: Update notes for v0.1.12
notes.content:
We've pushed a new update which includes:

* Players can now sleep (save) at any time. The length of sleep is proportional to tiredness.
* Hyperdrive fuel now burns consistently whether at navigation console or fuel loader.
* Updates save file UI to make scrollbar more visible. Removes empty save slots on load view.
* Fixes door sounds when locked.
* Implements new Pause In Background setting so you can keep travelling when the game loses focus.
* Fixes cargo slots not refreshing after emptying.
* Fixes save load day, map location and outfit.
* Adds cargo crane controls to navigation console under its own button.
* Increased base travel speed by 25% to shorten long haul journeys a bit.

A big thanks to everyone for providing such great feedback :)

notes.title: Update notes for v0.1.11
